61860dc13f130c9c.description: About the Role Plaza Premium Group is seeking a Lounge in Charge (Supervisor) to oversee lounge operations during assigned shifts in Abha, 'Asir. This full-time role involves acting as the Lounge In-Charge in the absence of the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager, ensuring high service excellence and operational efficiency. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Act as the Lounge In-Charge during assigned shifts, making operational decisions when the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager is absent. Supervise all lounge functions, including reception, F&B, and housekeeping, to ensure smooth operations. Oversee guest check-in and admission procedures in compliance with company policies. Greet, receive, and bid farewell to guests professionally. Handle guest enquiries, feedback, and complaints, ensuring prompt resolution. Support and guide Guest Service Officers in daily operations and customer interactions. Monitor lounge areas to ensure cleanliness, comfort, and readiness. Coordinate with housekeeping, maintenance, and kitchen teams to resolve operational issues. Oversee cash handling, billing, and accurate record-keeping. Ensure proper handling and documentation of lost and found items. Monitor adherence to service standards, grooming, and conduct of guest service staff. Assist in staff scheduling, attendance monitoring, and shift handovers. Ensure confidentiality of guest information and operational data. Support training and on-the-job coaching for guest service staff. Prepare basic operational reports and escalate issues to management as needed. Conduct lounge opening and closing procedures, ensuring full readiness. Monitor lounge capacity and guest flow, managing peak periods to maintain service standards. Handle incidents and emergencies, liaising with airport authorities, airlines, and partners. Monitor inventory levels and coordinate stock requisitions. Perform ad-hoc duties as assigned by the Lounge Manager or Duty Manager. Qualifications and Experience Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in guest service, hospitality, or airport lounge operations, with supervisory exposure. Required Skills Strong customer service orientation with effective problem-solving skills. Ability to lead, motivate, and support service teams in a fast-paced environment. Capability to independently manage lounge operations and make sound decisions during shifts. Good knowledge of service standards and guest handling procedures. Proficiency in handling cash transactions and maintaining accurate records. Professional appearance, positive attitude, and strong interpersonal skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Abha, requiring flexibility to work various shifts, including weekends and public holidays, to support continuous lounge operations.

610fbee387d75df3.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تعلن إحدى شركات المقاولات الرائدة في الرياض عن توفر شاغر وظيفي لـ مهندس ميكانيكي. يتطلب هذا الدور مهندسًا محترفًا ذا خبرة واسعة في مشاريع المقاولات، ويهدف إلى تعزيز القدرات الهندسية للشركة في تنفيذ وإدارة الأعمال الميكانيكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المعدات والنظم الميكانيكية، وتحديد معايير الأداء والجودة المطلوبة. إدارة عمليات تركيب المعدات والنظم، بما في ذلك إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة المعدات وتصليحها لضمان استمرارية التشغيل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الفنية المتخصصة، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة الحصول على تصنيف مهندس محترف ساري المفعول من الهيئة السعودية للمهندسين. خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 8 سنوات في مجال المقاولات والمشاريع الإنشائية. خبرة مثبتة في تنفيذ وإدارة الأعمال الميكانيكية ضمن المشاريع. إلمام شامل بأنظمة التكييف والتهوية (HVAC)، ومكافحة الحريق، وشبكات المياه والصرف الصحي (MEP). المهارات والكفاءات إجادة قراءة ومراجعة المخططات الهندسية والمواصفات الفنية بدقة. القدرة على الإشراف الفعال على التنفيذ ومتابعة أداء المقاولين، وإعداد التقارير الفنية اللازمة. إجادة استخدام البرامج الهندسية ذات الصلة بتخصص الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إدارة فرق العمل والتنسيق الفعال مع مختلف التخصصات الهندسية الأخرى. تفاصيل إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الرياض. يتم تحديد الراتب بعد المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

61c7835597673e04.description: About the Role Astek is seeking a Senior Executive Manager Audit Analytics to lead data analytics and continuous auditing initiatives within the Internal Audit function for one of its clients. This full-time role is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah or Makkah, and aims to enhance audit delivery through advanced analytics, automation, and data-driven assurance. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end continuous auditing and data analytics initiatives, covering requirements gathering, data extraction, testing, analysis, reporting, and closure. Develop analytical methodologies to identify emerging risks, control weaknesses, anomalies, trends, and exceptions. Utilize SAS for independent extraction, reconciliation, and analysis of large, complex datasets. Translate business processes, risk scenarios, policies, and controls into analytical logic and testing procedures. Investigate exceptions, conduct root-cause analysis, and differentiate genuine control issues from data-quality or process-related matters. Support audit engagements by identifying higher-risk populations and strengthening audit coverage. Engage with business, IT, Risk, and Audit stakeholders to understand processes, validate findings, and communicate insights. Enhance continuous auditing tools, automated analytics, dashboards, and reporting capabilities. Ensure analytical solutions are documented, validated, repeatable, and supported by appropriate governance and quality controls. Coach junior team members and contribute to the development of the Internal Audit function. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, or a related field. Around 8 years of relevant experience in data analytics, enterprise risk, assurance, financial analytics, model monitoring, or a similar area. Advanced, hands-on experience with SAS Enterprise and/or SAS Viya, including independent analysis of large, complex datasets. Strong understanding of risk, controls, testing, monitoring, and assurance concepts. Proven ability to lead complex analytical initiatives and work effectively with multiple stakeholders. Proficiency in English and Arabic. Preferred Skills and Certifications Experience in a regulated or complex organization. Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Python, data visualization, or automation. A relevant master’s degree or professional certification (such as CISA, CMA, CPA, or CRMA). Work Type and Location This is a full-time position located in the Makkah region, with primary work locations in Jeddah or Makkah. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

610c122a66f62f4d.description: Overview of the Role Abbott is seeking a TAVI GCC Therapy Leader to be based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for supporting business operations across the GCC region, specifically Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman. The role focuses on driving commercial growth, market development, and strategic execution for the Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI) business. Key Responsibilities The TAVI GCC Therapy Leader will combine commercial leadership, clinical understanding, account management, and cross-functional coordination to achieve business objectives. Responsibilities include: Developing and executing the GCC TAVI commercial strategy to meet sales, market share, and profitability targets. Identifying growth opportunities and creating territory development plans across GCC countries. Driving procedure growth through strategic account planning and customer engagement. Monitoring competitive activities and implementing effective counterstrategies. Forecasting sales performance and managing business pipelines accurately. Partnering with healthcare institutions to expand TAVI program adoption. Supporting the development of new TAVI centers and enhancing utilization within existing centers. Identifying barriers to patient access and collaborating with stakeholders to improve referral pathways. Driving awareness of TAVI therapy among physicians, hospital administrators, and healthcare decision-makers. Business Planning and Execution This role involves strategic planning and execution to ensure sustained growth and market presence for TAVI therapy. Specific duties include: Developing annual business plans and quarterly growth initiatives. Tracking key performance indicators such as implants, center productivity, market penetration, and conversion rates. Executing strategic projects aligned with regional and global priorities. Leading tender preparation and commercial negotiations where required. Clinical and Technical Support The TAVI GCC Therapy Leader will also provide essential clinical and technical support, ensuring effective therapy adoption and physician understanding. Maintaining strong knowledge of TAVI technology, clinical evidence, and treatment guidelines. Supporting customer education initiatives and physician training programs. Participating in major TAVI cases and therapy-focused events as needed. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in a similar capacity, demonstrating a strong background in commercial leadership and market development within the medical device or healthcare industry. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending across the GCC region. The role requires a commitment to accelerating therapy adoption and expanding patient access.

610099aba7301cd0.job_title: Sap Tax Technology Specialist Sap Monitoring Zakat
610099aba7301cd0.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking a Zakat, VAT & WHT Compliance Specialist to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves owning and maintaining tax rules, controls, and ZATCA-facing procedures to ensure audit readiness and compliance. Key Responsibilities Develop procedures for handling ZATCA queries, managing zakat and tax assessments, and filing objections and appeals. Establish a record-keeping framework for expenses, assets, and payments to ensure evidence is retrievable during assessments. Define VAT/WHT validation rules, control points, and thresholds for integration into the monitoring toolkit. Review monthly VAT and WHT returns using the toolkit, investigating and resolving exceptions prior to filing. Prepare zakat base computations and supporting schedules, reconciling them with ERP outputs. Act as the primary liaison with ZATCA and external auditors during reviews and inspections. Update internal tax policies and provide training to finance staff on new controls. Deliverables ZATCA query, assessment, and appeals procedure manual. Records-management framework and evidence index. VAT/WHT control matrix and validation rules. Monthly review checklist and exception log. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in tax compliance, specifically with Zakat, VAT, and WHT. Demonstrated understanding of ZATCA regulations and procedures. Experience in developing and implementing tax control frameworks. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires close collaboration with internal finance teams and external regulatory bodies. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

613e48c50ec17d02.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an SAP Tax Technology Specialist to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves configuring ERP systems and developing monitoring tools to ensure accurate capture, calculation, reporting, and flagging of Zakat, VAT, and WHT data. The specialist will be responsible for enhancing tax compliance and data integrity within the ERP environment. Key Responsibilities Assess the current ERP setup for tax codes, GL mapping, and master data, then address gaps related to Zakat, VAT, and WHT. Build or configure Zakat base tracking, calculation, and reporting functionalities within the ERP system. Integrate tax checks into daily posting processes and monthly close procedures to maintain continuous data accuracy. Develop the VAT/WHT validation and monitoring model, including return-to-GL reconciliation, sample tests, and exception logs. Configure alerts to notify management of discrepancies and unusual patterns, such as rate mismatches, missing WHT on foreign payments, or significant spikes compared to prior months. Design exportable, audit-ready reports in formats acceptable to ZATCA and external auditors. Document the implemented solution and provide training to finance users, followed by a handover to SAR's IT and tax teams. Required Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in SAP tax technology. The role requires a strong understanding of ERP tax configuration and tax compliance processes. Deliverables ERP tax configuration design and change log. VAT/WHT validation and monitoring toolkit, including models, dashboards, and alert rules. Zakat calculation and reporting module. Comprehensive report pack and user guide. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on critical tax technology implementations within an ERP environment. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

6183523a80ec8eb3.description: The Site Manager represents the Client on-site and oversees renovation activities to ensure safe, timely, and quality delivery in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, project requirements, and HSE standards. The role coordinates contractors and multidisciplinary stakeholders, monitors project progress, resolves site issues, and ensures the successful completion and handover of renovated housing units. Key Responsibilities Act as the Client’s primary representative at the project site and coordinate with the PMC, contractors, designers, operations, and end users. Monitor renovation progress, contractor performance, schedules, resources, and site constraints. Coordinate civil, architectural, electrical, mechanical, and other construction activities. Ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, quality standards, and HSE requirements. Identify and resolve technical issues, risks, delays, and site coordination challenges. Lead site coordination meetings, track action items, and review contractor progress reports. Coordinate inspections, snagging, testing and commissioning, defect closure, and final handover. Liaise with operations and facilities management to confirm housing unit readiness. Provide regular management reports on progress, risks, delays, and required decisions. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 10 years of construction and site-management experience. Proven experience in housing renovation, residential refurbishment, or building construction. Experience managing multidisciplinary contractors and coordinating site activities. Strong knowledge of health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements. Project or construction management certification preferred; relevant professional registration where required. Key Competencies Site leadership and stakeholder management. Construction planning, coordination, and problem-solving. Quality assurance and HSE compliance. Reporting, communication, and decision-making.

61a5982c1b7a4e9a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على مراجعة وتدقيق استمارات البيانات، بالإضافة إلى إدخال وتخزين المعلومات باستخدام أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدخال البيانات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة استمارات البيانات وترميزها لضمان اكتمالها ودقتها. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات إلى أنظمة الحاسب الآلي وفقاً للبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصحيح أي أخطاء موجودة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بطريقة منظمة وآمنة. إجراء النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة بشكل دوري. الالتزام الصارم بالتعليمات والسياسات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدخال البيانات أو دور مشابه. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج إدخال البيانات وأنظمة الحاسب الآلي. المهارات الأساسية الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسرية المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل مدخل البيانات ضمن فريق متخصص، ويكون مسؤولاً عن الحفاظ على دقة وسلامة البيانات والمعلومات الخاصة بالشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على تقديم طلباتهم.

61fc2cdeaf085335.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى وضع برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الميكانيكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. وضع خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم لبرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية سيتم تحديد الراتب بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

61496ae0d0029152.description: About the University of Prince Mugrin The University of Prince Mugrin (UPM), established in 2017 and located in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, is dedicated to providing advanced university education. UPM offers contemporary educational curricula and materials designed to support students in building their future careers. Ability to use relevant security technology, digital learning tools, surveillance/control-room systems, or other technologies applicable to assigned courses. Professional certifications, licenses, specialist training, or recognized operational qualifications relevant to the teaching assignment are desirable and should be verified where applicable. Develop and implement comprehensive crop management plans, including planting schedules, irrigation strategies, fertilization programs, and pest control measures. 619671ef94a3fe0c.description: Job description Job Details: Job Description: About the role Be the technical face of Intel's Agentic Platform for customers across Saudi Arabia and the broader MENA region. As an early-career Solution Customer Success Engineer, you will guide enterprise and government customers from first conversation through successful deployment of agentic AI on Intel hardware - supporting the Kingdom's transformation under Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Strategy for Data and AI (NSDAI). You will run technical demos, design and run proofs of concept, troubleshoot deployments, gather field feedback, and help customers realize value from the platform - all while bridging Arabic-speaking customer teams and Intel's global engineering organization. 61477722b7e8894f.description: About the Role ITHR Technologies Consulting is seeking a highly experienced SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting Quality Assurance Consultant to support a large-scale SAP S/4HANA implementation program for a leading Oil & Gas organization in Saudi Arabia. 61620cb8ff049b4e.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن مؤسسة رعدالمحيط للمقاولات العامة عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام والخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم العمليات المالية والمحاسبية للمؤسسة، ويعد فرصة للمحاسبين ذوي الخبرة من سنة إلى ثلاث سنوات لتعزيز مسيرتهم المهنية في بيئة عمل متكاملة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تسجيل ومراجعة القيود والمعاملات المحاسبية بدقة. متابعة الحسابات المدينة والدائنة وضمان تحديثها بانتظام. إعداد ومراجعة الفواتير والمصروفات لضمان الامتثال المالي. إجراء التسويات البنكية ومطابقة الحسابات بشكل دوري. إعداد التقارير المحاسبية والمالية اللازمة للإدارة. تنظيم وحفظ المستندات والملفات المحاسبية بطريقة منهجية. استخدام برامج Excel والبرامج المحاسبية المتخصصة لمتابعة البيانات والحسابات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من سنة إلى ثلاث سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. إتقان استخدام برامج Microsoft Excel. القدرة على استخدام البرامج المحاسبية المتخصصة. الالتزام بالدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع المهام المحاسبية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل مؤسسة رعدالمحيط للمقاولات العامة. تقع مواقع العمل في مدينتي الدمام والخبر، مما يوفر بيئة عمل ديناميكية ومتنوعة. المزايا المالية يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي، ويتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم الشروط المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى فريق عمل مؤسسة رعدالمحيط للمقاولات العامة.
